$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 — C1-C5 (CE-2152) the squad's casualty-care drill. From the header's Judge (2)-(4): the check drops Rifleman 3 to 25 HP at contact (the live check's set_health; contact = the first round at the Hostile), the Medic and only he carries, covering rounds precede him, the man is carried then put down alive. 'Medic goes' is his CarryCasualty task, so 'covering fire first' is stricter than the live '1 m out'. NOT expressed: (1) Rescue winning the decision (an unreadable utility winner), (4) the squad leaving CasualtyCare (a task cue cannot be negated), (5) no order to the man down and the 2.5 m cover-point distance (maneuver data read over HTTP, not components). The take never fired its cues (it had no action). TRIAGE (CE-4042): (a) the squad's drill IS readable — the Squad entity's SquadDrillTrace component (Active, Kind, Phase, Care.Stage; Kind 11 = CasualtyCare, 12 = FireAndMovement, 7 = SquadHold), so 'the squad runs CasualtyCare' is a field cue, not a task cue (DESIGN §9 'squad drill' gap is closed for this); (b) IsEmbarkedTag.Mode is not in the entity dump (the translator writes Vehicle + Seat only) — carried / put down is the embark cue (IsEmbarkedTag present / gone). Measured: the drill starts 3.5 s, the Medic goes 4.75 s, the man is carried 14.25 s, put down 24.25 s.
